name: Optics
notes: Five optics courses, one of which must be laboratory-based. A grade of C or better is required in each.
Independent research for credit may substitute for the laboratory course - not modeled.
The two free electives must be 200-level four-credit optics courses, excluding OPT 287.

requirementGroups.label: Required optics courses
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Complete both required optics courses: OPT 241: Geometrical Optics; OPT 261: Interference and Diffraction

requirementGroups.label: Optics laboratory
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Plus one of following optics labs: OPT 201: Geometrical Optics Lab; OPT 202: Physical Optics Lab; OPT 203: Instrumentation Lab; OPT 204: Sources and Detectors Lab; Independent research for credit

requirementGroups.label: 200-level optics electives (2)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Plus two 200-level, four-credit optics (with the exception of OPT 287).
